Start a Family Profile

How does AdoptTogether work?

See FAQs

Adopting Family

Create a family profile with your adoption story, family photo, and fundraising goal.

Once your profile is complete, you can begin fundraising for your adoption expenses.

Generous Supporter

AdoptTogether is a project of Hoping Hearts Foundation, a 501(c)3 organization, and will be designated to the adopting family you choose to support.

Your tax deductible donation to our General Fund will help support the work of AdoptTogether.

Testimonials

Success Stories

Without AdoptTogether we would not have been able to grow our family through adoption at this point in our lives. AdoptTogether allowed us to engage our friends and family through tax-deductible fundraising.

The Wittigs - Adopted from Uganda

We are thankful for AdoptTogether! In our adoption journey, over 1,500 different people donated through AdoptTogether to help bring Thaddeus home. We did not do this alone, we literally did 'Adopt Together.

The Gulletts - Adopted from the US

AdoptTogether provided a simple way for people to make donations. Receiving our money when we were ready to travel was also as simple as sending an email. When you are in the midst of paperwork and travel plans, the simplicity of AdoptTogether is so appreciated.

The Robinsons - Adopted from China

After an adoption without any financial support, we knew that adopting again would be a challenge. Then we heard about AdoptTogether. The process was easy, the staff was amazingly supportive, and the ability for our family and friends to give toward our adoption costs is simply amazing.

The Crooks - Adopted from the US

AdoptTogether is a simple partnership that will bless your family and breathe new life into the sails of your adoption journey. We have told everyone we know who is adopting about AdoptTogether and we recommend them to you enthusiastically.

Test Author

We knew that we needed a financial partner while adopting our daughter from China. AdoptTogether was our answer to prayer! Many friends, businesses and anonymous donors blessed our family, completely funding the adoption cost of $39,500! Our family will forever be grateful to God for the gift of AdoptTogether!

The Butchers - Adopted from China
